_comment: De-PII'd /v1/user/info for hermetic /gpus-console/upgrade. This route renders the gpus-console SPA shell (side nav + header + GlobalNotice); its own page.tsx is an empty fragment and Main.tsx has no matching func for 'upgrade', so the SPA body content area stays empty. user/info only acts as the auth gate here (token cookie + a successful response with uuid keeps the session from being treated as logged-out). teams:[] keeps currentTeam null. All identifying fields are synthetic placeholders, no real PII.
